purpose: Teach: 酔い/湿気/寒かっ/叱ら/落ち込み/思い浮かべ/縁起/引っ張る

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、夏祭りで甘酒、酔いまではいかなかった。
lines.en: Yesterday at the summer fest, the amazake didn't quite get me tipsy.
lines.style: Light, conversational opening. Quick pace, natural teen cadence. A small smile in the voice—noticing something about herself. Leaning into the memory.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夜、湿気で寝苦しかったよな。
lines.en: The humidity at night made it impossible to sleep properly.
lines.style: Sympathetic complaint, delivered with understated weariness. Slight conspiratorial tone—acknowledging shared discomfort. Matter-of-fact, not self-pitying.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: But then the morning was cold, weirdly enough.
lines.style: Observational, almost conversational surprise. Gentle tone. Noticing the contrast, nodding it through. Warm toward him—continuing the thread.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 担任に叱られて、休み時間、皆、静かだった。
lines.en: Our homeroom teacher got on us, and everyone went really quiet during break.
lines.style: Quieter than before. The weight of it settling in. Careful with the words—not dramatizing but not hiding it either. Eye contact drops slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 落ち込みすぎないでね。
lines.style: Firm but not cold. The shift from observer to defender. Direct eye contact. Steady, no-nonsense rhythm. Genuine concern underneath the straightforwardness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 母さんの料理を思い浮かべると、頑張れる。
lines.en: When I think about Mom's cooking, I can push through.
lines.style: Softer now, more vulnerable. A small smile surfaces. Honest admission—not trying to seem strong. Quiet conviction. Pause before the last phrase.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、縁起担ぎでカツ丼食べた?
lines.en: Did you do the whole katsudon good-luck thing before exams?
lines.style: Lighter touch returns. Curiosity without pressure. Playful, almost teasing. Testing whether he's taking care of himself. Quick, engaged rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いや、まだ。ゴール手前、ラスト引っ張る気力、貯めとくよ。
lines.en: Not yet. I'm saving my strength for the final push—want to make it count when it matters.
lines.style: Wry but warmer. Deliberate pacing on the key phrase. There's self-awareness here, maybe even humor at his own strategy. A glance up—inviting her to get it.
